EmailTemplate.subject: Join us tomorrow at the Becker’s HIT Conference
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
We hope you’ll join us tomorrow at 10:00am CT as we host our featured session “How Covid-19 brought the digital revolution to healthcare and what innovative systems are doing about it” <[[https://view.ceros.com/beckers-healthcare/2021-hit-rcm-virtual-forum/p/11?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]>led by Flywire’s SVP of Healthcare, Tomer Shoval.
The pandemic has forever changed the way we should look at financial care for our patients. Join our session tomorrow and get the tips that will put you on the right path to better digital engagement and greater patient satisfaction.
If you haven’t registered for the conference yet, you can do so here! <[[https://view.ceros.com/beckers-healthcare/2021-hit-rcm-virtual-forum/p/1?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=emai]]>
We hope to see you there!
Regards,
